chapter_title: Concerning the Fourteen Vehicles that Jesus has bo
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Ten Degrees of Divine Descent

**¶2:** When Divine Truth proceeding from Infinite Love descended into the planes of human consciousness, at the time when the Divine itself was unveiled, it assumed ten successive degrees of containment. By means of these it passed through every state of the mind, from inmost to outmost.

**¶3:** The first containing degree is the vessel of pure Divine Wisdom, for there Divine Truth receives its commission from the Divine Proceeding itself — the mediating presence through which the Infinite communicates with the finite.

**¶4:** The second containing degree is the vessel of the celestial human in its primordial form, for the dwelling-place of the Divine is established in the inmost of the archetypal human mind.

**¶5:** The third is the upright axis of Divine Good made manifest as the complete regenerated human — for there Divine Truth shone forth visibly. It descended into lower degrees and became apparent in the natural mind.

**¶6:** The fourth is the Divine calling which was invested as an exterior form around the indwelling presence. The fifth is the responsive will — the good of obedience — which was wrapped around the calling truth as its living garment.

**¶7:** The sixth is the living sphere of spiritual perception, and because the Divine assumed this sphere also, it was consecrated with the anointing of power there. The seventh is the living influx of the spirit that flows actively into the understanding. The eighth is the illumination that makes interior things visible. The ninth is living truth that purifies and regenerates. The tenth is Divine Love itself — the inmost fire — which is above and within all the other degrees.

**¶8:** The Divine Truth progressed through all these ten degrees of containment, through every angelic society and every [GAP-1] arrangement of spiritual life, both the interior celestial states and the exterior natural states.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When Jesus the Son of Greatness came to these worlds, at the time that he unveiled the greatness, he boarded ten vehicles. He journeyed in the universe by them.
The first vehicle is the light ship, since he received instructions from the Ambassador there.
The second carriage is the ship of the First Man, since his dwelling is established there.
The third is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man, since he shone forth there. He came below, he appeared in the world.
The fourth is the summons that he clothed upon his body. The fifth is the obedience that he swathed upon the summons.

The sixth is the living air, and since he assumed it too, he received anointment there. The seventh is the living wind that blows. The eighth is the light that illuminates. The ninth is the living water. The tenth is the living fire that is above them all.
He was journeying in these ten carriages among all the orders and all the [aeons], those above and those below.

fills.explanation: In Manichaean Kephalaia vocabulary, "orders and aeons" is a standard cosmological doublet describing angelic societies and their cosmic realms/arrangements; the spiritual reading confirms this as "arrangements of spiritual life" qualified by interior and exterior states.
